hero.title: VClaw helps small businesses operate sales, payments, and follow-up from one local-first web surface.
hero.description: Built on OpenClaw as a controlled product fork, VClaw turns fragmented chat-based operations into a clear commerce workflow for non-technical operators.

summaryCards.title: Local-first
summaryCards.copy: Keep operational data and workflows close to the operator environment.

summaryCards.title: Web-first
summaryCards.copy: Designed for day-to-day operators rather than technical setup flows.

summaryCards.title: Operator-safe
summaryCards.copy: Add approval gates around sensitive actions such as payments and follow-up.

cockpit.title: VClaw operator cockpit
cockpit.description: Inbox, payments, bookings, orders, and follow-up in one place

problem.title: Small operators lose time across fragmented chat, payment, and booking tools.
problem.description: VClaw translates the BRD and architecture docs into a product surface where sales operations feel like one workflow instead of scattered screenshots, notes, and copy-paste tasks.

cards.title: Chat is fragmented
cards.copy: Leads arrive from different channels and important replies are easy to miss.

cards.title: Payment review is manual
cards.copy: Operators still inspect QR data and transfer screenshots by hand.

cards.title: Follow-up gets dropped
cards.copy: Without one workflow, reminders and post-sale actions fall through the cracks.

capabilities.title: From payment assist to booking workflows, the UI follows the product docs.

items.title: VietQR payment assist
items.description: Generate payment instructions from chat context so sellers can close payments faster with fewer manual steps.

items.title: Bill verification support
items.description: Review transfer screenshots, compare transaction details, and surface what still needs operator confirmation.

items.title: Address and shipping normalization
items.description: Turn messy chat addresses into structured delivery-ready information and estimate shipping cost.

items.title: Booking and reminder workflows
items.description: Manage appointment slots, booking states, and reminders from one operator-first admin surface.

surfaces.title: The website and admin shell mirror the layered VClaw operating model.
surfaces.description: Public docs explain the product. The admin shell shows how the operator surface can evolve into a production control console.

items.title: Local Web Admin
items.description: The main operator console for onboarding, payments, bookings, inbox, and commerce workflows.

items.title: Remote Access
items.description: An optional secure remote layer when the operator needs to manage the system away from the machine.

items.title: Chat-native shortcuts
items.description: Fast actions through Telegram menus or similar chat surfaces for quick approvals and status checks.

commerce.title: Commerce workflow
commerce.description: The UI aligns with the SMB commerce journey described in the commerce use-case docs.
steps: Lead intake from chat or online source

openClaw.title: Built on OpenClaw
openClaw.description: VClaw uses OpenClaw as the execution substrate while investing in product UX, safety, and business workflows.
points: Controlled product fork instead of a full rewrite
Future-ready for remote access and chat-native shortcuts

finalCta.badge: Ready for documentation and UI review
finalCta.title: Explore the product docs or jump straight into the admin shell demo.
finalCta.description: The current website is designed to act as both a product-facing landing page and the frontend-ready foundation for future VClaw operations tooling.
